headline: GRIND CITY learns the revert — lines keep flowing
lede: Flagship slice 2 lands the genre's connective verb: land a trick on a transition while rolling and the landing itself pays +100 as its own trick, while the combo bank clock restarts in the wall. Rails into ramps into air, one line.

notes.text: REVERT +100 unique: a clean landing whose air carried a grab, flip, spin or paid Big Air, hitting a slope in the 0.30–1.60 transition band at 4 m/s or more, joins the chain on its own — and resets the bank timer, so the line survives the touchdown (+36 fresh ticks of reach, pinned in grindcheck).

Honesty: both autopilots discovered the verb on their own lines (one pipe-wall revert each), so the bot score pins moved deliberately, in the same PR with the README law — witness 19280, searched 21940, byte-frozen from here. 31/31 mutants caught, waiting lines untouched (RUN_V holds at 3).

The park's geometry stays honest: the slope band excludes flat plaza and the height-field's invisible side-cliffs, so reverts pay only on walls a human can actually carve — pipe, quarterpipe, kicker, pumped drop-in.
